_metadata.description: Measurement-backed optimization runs with approval gates.

requirements.title: Optimization runs compare candidates before applying changes
requirements.description: The scenario shall run baseline, candidate, and after measurements; score candidates with reliability-first metrics; preserve an experiment ledger; and require explicit approval before any persistent configuration change is applied.

validation.notes: Add experiment-runner tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-005] for baseline/candidate sequencing, scoring, approval gating, timeout handling, and rollback selection.
